description: This source file defines character utility functions for Unicode case mapping, including a lookup table for converting uppercase Latin characters to lowercase, and a function 'latin_tolower' that performs binary search on this table. It appears to be part of an input method editor (IME) for Android, specifically related to next-word prediction or text processing.
